title: Quiz Rush Arcade
premise: A neon-styled arcade trivia run where the player teams up with a robot mascot to answer rapid-fire multiple-choice prompts and maintain a perfect streak.
interaction_model: Single-screen multiple-choice quiz interaction with tap/click answer selection and start/restart buttons.
objective: Reach the target streak by answering each generated question correctly; any wrong answer immediately ends the run.
progression: Linear short-session progression based on consecutive correct answers, with instant fail on mistakes and a win once the configured target score is met.
theme: Retro-futurist arcade trivia with a friendly bot host, glowing UI panels, and celebratory reaction effects.
mood: Energetic, punchy, playful, and lightly tense because each answer can end the streak.
likely_audience: Casual browser and mobile players, trivia fans, younger players, and anyone who enjoys short arcade score-chase sessions.
confidence_notes: High confidence that the game is fundamentally a quiz game with arcade presentation.
High confidence that progression is streak-based because score increments only on correct answers and any wrong answer ends the run.
Moderate confidence on audience targeting beyond general casual/mobile players.
recreation_prompt: Create a polished one-screen browser game called "Quiz Rush Arcade," presented as a neon retro-futuristic trivia challenge hosted by a cute robot mascot. The game should open on a stylish start card with glowing arcade fonts, a short description about building a streak, and a large start button. When the player begins, show a HUD with the current streak and target score, then present one multiple-choice question at a time in a central card. Questions should be procedurally generated from a small rotating set of categories such as quick math, world capitals, and simple pattern or logic sequences, with four answer buttons per prompt and only one correct answer. The interaction must be tap/click only: the player reads the prompt and selects an answer. Correct answers should immediately increase the streak, play a success sound, flash the chosen button green, show a celebratory reaction, and spawn confetti before the next question appears after a brief delay. Wrong answers should turn the selected answer red, reveal the correct answer, play a failure sound, shake the screen, show a fail reaction, and end the run after a short pause. The player wins by reaching a configurable target streak, which should trigger a trophy-style victory screen, looping celebration effects, and a replay button. A loss screen should show the final streak and offer a retry button. Use a full-screen animated background canvas with soft floating particles behind the UI, glassy HUD panels, bold arcade typography, responsive mobile-safe layout, and upbeat background music plus UI sound effects to make the game feel like a fast, replayable arcade quiz score attack.
